# Eren Korkmaz

> AI engineer and independent consultant: backend, infrastructure, AI pipelines and platforms. Go, Python, Rust.

I help teams turn complicated problems into clean, working software: scalable backend services, the infrastructure and DevOps lifecycle around them, and AI systems from data pipelines and LLM applications to serving them in production. I work independently, as a consultant or contractor.

I build with the future in mind, choosing architecture and scalability for the use case from the start, and do my best work in collaborative, cross-cultural teams.

## Focus

- Backend services
- Infrastructure and DevOps
- AI and data pipelines
- LLM applications and agents
- Model serving and platform
- Evals and reliability
